capabilities: Toggle the native Excluded files list from a ribbon icon or command
Stash exclusion entries to plugin storage and restore them on the second click
Refresh Search and Graph views automatically after toggling
Merge entries added while filters are off back into the list on restore
Restore the exclusion list when the plugin is disabled or uninstalled
extras: Relies on undocumented Obsidian APIs (Vault.getConfig/setConfig and search/graph view internals) that may break on Obsidian updates; the plugin self-disables with a notice if the config API disappears, and the README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: operates on Obsidian's built-in Settings → Files and links → Excluded files list — it doesn't maintain its own
problem: Obsidian can hide noisy folders via the Excluded files setting, but there is no quick way to temporarily reveal them without manually editing that list.
summary: Ribbon and command toggle that switches Obsidian's native Excluded files list on and off to hide or reveal folders in file explorer, search and graph.
